newsitem.title: USA: Conn. atty genl hails dismissal of Indian suits.
newsitem.headline: Conn. atty genl hails dismissal of Indian suits.

text.p: Connecticut Attorney General Richard Blumenthal on Monday hailed a state judge's dismissal of lawsuits filed by an Indian tribe claiming land from thousands of property owners in four cities and towns.
A superior court judge in Milford, Conn., dismissed the four lawsuits filed by the Golden Hill Paugussetts who several months ago lost their bid for federal recognition as an Indian tribe.
"This dismissal should end the effort to hold hostage these property owners, and spare them the expense and anxiety of needless litigation," Blumenthal said in a statement.
The Golden Hill Paugussetts had claimed land from property owners in Seymour, Shelton, Trumbull, and Bridgeport, Conn.
